verdicts.rationale: CONFIRMED - Critical numeric boundary validation bug. Contract requires shard_number >= 1 (lower bound enforced via NonZeroU32 wrapper), but no upper bound validation exists. Source code confirms direct pass-through of shard_number value with no range check. Testing proves shard_number values >=35 cause server crash (container exit 137), while shard_number=30 succeeds. This is a true Type1_IllegalSuccess: API accepts invalid extreme values without 4xx error, instead causing complete service denial (crash). Contrast with replication_factor=0 which correctly returns HTTP 400 with explicit validation error, proving the validation infrastructure exists but is inconsistently applied.
